QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_16

question.text: Typical annual Trusteeship Fees for an AIF are in the range of:

answer.text: INR 1 lakh to INR 5 lakh per year depending on fund size
INR 50 lakh to INR 1 crore per year

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that trusteeship fees are typically fixed at INR 1 lakh to INR 5 lakh per year depending on the size of the fund, as agreed in the offer letter with the Trustee. The Trap: Option B is unrealistically high relative to the workbook range. Options C and D confuse trusteeship fees with management fees, which are charged on AUM or capital commitments. Note: Anchor the answer to the source range and remember trusteeship fees are a fixed annual amount, not a percentage of AUM.
